comment: C ref: save.c dosave0():111-124, the old save file. Segment 1 saves a debug-mode game. Segment 2 restores it and answers y to unixmain.c's "Do you want to keep the save file?", so the file stays; the next save finds it, and the answer n to "Overwrite the old file?" keeps it and returns to the game through dosave()'s docrt(). ^P then shows the messages the declined save filed. A second save answers y and overwrites the file. Segment 3 restores the overwritten file, declines to keep it, and pages back through the restored message history. Seed, clock and character chosen independently.
